label: Job Description
description: Write or revise role descriptions, responsibilities, qualifications, and hiring signals.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a job description or hiring profile.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for employment-law compliance review.

label: Interview Planning
description: Create interview loops, questions, rubrics, and evaluation criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to interview for a role or assess skills.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to make a hiring decision from protected characteristics.

label: Candidate Screening Support
description: Summarize job-relevant candidate materials against explicit criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to screen resumes or compare candidates against stated job requirements.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to infer protected attributes or make unlawful employment decisions.

label: Sourcing Message
description: Draft candidate outreach and sourcing messages.

label: Scorecard Creation
description: Create hiring scorecards, competencies, and evaluation criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a hiring scorecard.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for learner quiz rubric.

label: Interview Feedback
description: Structure interview notes and job-relevant feedback.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to write interview feedback.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to infer protected attributes.

label: Offer Preparation
description: Prepare offer discussion points, constraints, and candidate communication.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for payroll/legal final approval.

label: Pipeline Update
description: Summarize hiring pipeline status, blockers, and next steps.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for recruiting pipeline update.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for sales pipeline update.

label: Role Intake
description: Define hiring role intake questions, requirements, and constraints.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to scope a role opening.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for job ad copy only.

label: Candidate Comparison Support
description: Compare candidates against explicit job criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to compare candidate materials using a rubric.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for unlawful or protected-class inference.
